subject: Board ops: ARR Spotlight — stage true-up & audit handoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: board-secretariat@rowancapital.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Board ops: ARR Spotlight — stage true-up & audit handoff

Team —

We need one consolidated pass for the ARR Spotlight section of the board packet. High level asks:

1) Stage hygiene: run the "Stage true‑up" HubSpot filter and move any deals that do not meet evidence criteria out of Commit / Commit P0. If you believe a deal still belongs in Commit, add a one‑line rationale.
2) Evidence: upload supporting artifacts to the Drive folder (link below). Typical acceptable artifacts: signed contract, PO (amount + date), billing setup confirmation, documented executive verbal confirmation in email chain. For trials or pilots we need a clear conversion trigger note and expected close date.
3) Top 5 deals: Ben, please annotate the top five Commit deals with an ARR delta (best/likely/worst) and attach a one‑page snapshot for each.
4) RevOps playbook: Monica, please run the true‑up script and drop the stage_trueup_playbook.pdf into the folder; schedule two drop‑in office hours for next week.

Deadlines: please complete updates and uploads by COB Monday, Nov 30 PT. We will freeze the board packet on Dec 1 morning.

Attachments: ARR_support_matrix.xlsx (template), deal_snapshot_ACME.pdf (example).

Links: Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3CARR-BoardPrep
HubSpot filter: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/pipelines?filter=stage_trueup
Sprint notes: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/sprint/ARR-spotlight-notes

Thanks — we need clean traceability for the board and for the investor diligence team. Please be explicit about any judgement calls.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Board ops: ARR Spotlight — stage true-up & audit handoff

Vanessa — thanks, will do. Quick clarifying Qs:

- For deals with verbal commitments only (exec confirmed on call, no PO yet), should we move them to "Commit — contingent" with a one‑line rationale and expected PO date, or pull them to Best/Commit‑watch?
- For multi‑year deals with partial milestone invoicing, is the full ARR counted now or pro‑rated until billing is live? (I think we should count contracted ARR; just confirming the investor asks).

I'll start with the west region top 5 and upload snapshots to the Drive.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Board ops: ARR Spotlight — stage true-up & audit handoff

Thanks Vanessa — I ran a preliminary pass this morning and will do a full reconciliation over the weekend. High‑level plan and clarifications:

1) Evidence criteria (short):
   • Signed contract (pdf) with effective date OR
   • PO with amount and date OR
   • Email thread from named exec (company domain) confirming formal approval + expected PO date OR
   • Billing account/provisioned cluster confirmation (billing reference)
   
   Trials/pilots: must have a documented conversion trigger in the deal timeline and an assigned internal owner. If not, move to Best/Won‑watch.

2) Treatment of multi‑year deals: count contracted ARR for board narrative; we will annotate accounting treatment in appendix (finance will reconcile actual revenue recognition).

3) Office hours / support: scheduled two 30‑minute slots for Mon 11/30 at 10:00 PT and Tue 12/1 at 08:30 PT. Calendar links (will be created and shared in the Drive).

4) Deliverables: I will drop the stage_trueup_playbook.pdf into the folder and populate ARR_support_matrix.xlsx with reconciliation notes per deal. Expect a revops output file named revops_trueup_20261130.csv.

If anyone wants me to run a targeted filter (e.g., multi‑year >$250k or legal outstanding), shout and I'll include it in the sweep.

Monica Patel
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
